terminals.name: tilt
terminals.description: Canonical dev loop. Continuously builds the WASM engine bundles (wasm), regenerates card-data.json (card-data), serves the Vite frontend at http://localhost:5173 (frontend), and runs the deck-import lobby worker at http://localhost:8787 (lobby-worker). Read results with `tilt logs <resource> --tail 50` or `./scripts/tilt-wait.sh <resource>`; do not run cargo/pnpm builds directly. Start optional groups with `tilt up -- server test lint`.
